Executive interpretation

Technical: 504,483 of 699,110 cells passed configured filters. Q20 assignment was 89.0%; median control fraction was 0.000%. Spatial QC still requires inspection because acceptable global metrics can hide local artifacts.

Biological: marker modules resolve epithelial, immune, stromal and vascular compartments while 35.6% of passing cells remain explicitly unresolved. Neighborhood enrichment and Moran's I are hypothesis-generating and require pathology or independent reference validation.

Marker-module labels are working annotations, not clinical diagnoses. The spatial graph uses 200,000 reproducibly sampled cells for scalability; cell QC and annotation cover all cells.

Methods and reproducibility

  1. Stream transcript parquet to calculate QV and assignment metrics.
  2. Exclude controls; compute per-cell genes, transcripts, control fraction and segmentation geometry flags.
  3. Library-size normalize, log transform, fit SVD on a reproducible subset, then transform and cluster all passing cells.
  4. Assign conservative marker-module labels using minimum score and margin thresholds.
  5. Build a physical k-nearest-neighbor graph, permutation-test cell adjacency and calculate Moran's I.
